parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Section II; Equations 1-4; Table IV; Table V; Figure 4.
parameter_provenance.V0: Section IV and Table V: V0,0=5.9026(4) A^3/atom from the ambient-pressure thermal-expansion fit, multiplied by 8 atoms per conventional cell
parameter_provenance.K0: Section IV and Table V: B0,0=397(2) GPa, obtained by adding the cited 2 GPa 0-to-300 K correction to the 295 K Vinet modulus
parameter_provenance.K0_prime: Section IV and Table V: B0,0'=3.62(5), fixed equal to the 295 K Vinet value
parameter_provenance.thermal.Tr: Section III and Table IV: 295 K is the measured room-temperature series and is retained as the record's default/reporting temperature; absolute_zero means it is not subtracted from the total thermal pressure
parameter_provenance.thermal.theta0: Section IV, Equation 3, and Table V: theta0=1700 K adopted from infrared and heat-capacity literature; no uncertainty is reported
parameter_provenance.thermal.gamma0: Section V and Table V: gamma_th0=1.04(2), fixed during the q-only P-V-T fit
parameter_provenance.thermal.q: Section V and Table V: q=4(1.5), the only varied parameter in the final P-V-T fit
parameter_provenance.thermal.n: Equation 3 is the three-mode Debye energy per mole of atoms; n=2 on Peritheos's per-mole-BN volume basis
parameter_provenance.equation: Equations 2-4 and Section V: 0 K Vinet cold pressure plus absolute Debye vibrational pressure, with gamma=gamma0(V/V0)^q and theta obtained by integrating gamma=-d ln(theta)/d ln(V)

superseded_record_text.notes: This is not the existing 295 K Vinet record with a reference-subtracted thermal increment. Datchi et al. explicitly define Pth(V,T)=0 at 0 K and Table V supplies a distinct 0 K cold Vinet curve. Peritheos therefore uses thermal_pressure_reference=absolute_zero while keeping Tr=295 K only as the public default temperature and for reference-relative diagnostics. At the printed Table IV lattice parameters, the published coefficients give a 0.584 GPa pressure RMSE, reproducing the paper's stated 0.6 GPa. A q-only unweighted pressure-residual refit gives q=7.35(1.89); the discrepancy from 4(1.5) is less than two combined standard deviations and is plausibly affected by rounded P/a rows and the unpublished regression weights. Section IV's gamma_th0=1.04(1) conflicts with final Table V's 1.04(2); this record follows the final parameter table. The source states that parenthetical errors are fit standard deviations, not absolute uncertainties; pressure-scale uncertainty dominates and coefficient covariance is not published.
validity_notes: Marginal envelope of Table IV; 295 K compression reaches 162.5 GPa, whereas heated compression reaches 900 K and 84.2 GPa and the 948 K observation is at ambient pressure.
The record represents zinc-blende c-BN only; no transition was observed in the 295 K compression range.
